payload.summary: Every developer hub page renders twice in the browser during development
payload.detail: In a dev browser, /mockups/development/test-health and /mockups/development/ingestion each produce two copies of the page in one document - two panel roots and two <main> elements. Confirmed NOT caused by the ingestion work: test-health is already merged to main and doubles identically, and it predates that branch. Confirmed dev-only and not a production defect: curl of both routes returns exactly one <main> each, so the server-rendered output is correct. Two <main> elements would be a real document-structure and accessibility problem if it ever reached a production build, so it is worth establishing the cause rather than leaving it as folklore. Found while live-checking the ingestion panel.
